## The ruling

**A — the freeze is lifted for exactly this split, and restores itself when the split lands.** Scope of the lift: the gate roster (which paths feed which gate families) moves out as a data file; the engine keeps only roster loading, path matching and derivation; the self-test splits into a fast tier run on every dev delivery (roster load, path match, derivation) and a slow tier run in CI or on demand (the full fixture replay); #22167's `--tier` note is reworded to ruling C's meaning in the same PR, which closes #22167. Conditions, each part of the ruling: (1) before the split, the dev measures whether the existing self-tests cover every derivation path and adds a pin for each path they do not; (2) the derivation output is byte-identical before and after, proven in the PR, with the battery's seconds before and after beside it; (3) nothing else in the file changes under this lift, and once the PR lands the freeze is back as ruling 208 states it (touched only when the workflow it feeds breaks). ⛔ Not taken: B (the 30,049-line instrument stays a permanent debt, the contradiction stays, every delivery keeps paying the lock), C (the label changes, the instrument does not).

Prior rulings read: ruling 208 (card 19491, record 5755284987), lifted here for this one split and restored on landing; #22167 ruling C (6053791774), whose remainder rides the same PR; #21719 (closed, the same lock hold measured); #22060 (the program anchor and the 2026-10-09 dispatch-hold lift). `check-prior-rulings` over 6 terms → 5 ADR hits, none on this instrument; thread: none. 自检: 只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转:否(② 今天每次交付都在付锁;③ 逐字节 pin 让搬错一行响亮;④ 零新增零件)。置信缺口:既有自检对派生路径的覆盖率未量(条件 1 先量);快档的作用域边界按本裁的指引,由 dev 在 PR 里定稿。
